strategy.name: Opening Range Breakout
strategy.description: Looks at the first 5-minute candle of the day. If it closed up, the bot goes long; if it closed down, it goes short. The stop-loss sits at the other end of that candle, and everything is closed shortly before the market closes. It only trades stocks whose opening volume is at least normal, because the idea works best on busy days.
strategy.schedule: Looks at the first candle at 9:35 AM ET, may enter until 9:50 AM ET, and closes everything 5 minutes before the close.
rules: If the first 5-minute candle (9:30 to 9:35 AM ET) closed up, go long. If it closed down, go short.
Only trade a stock when its opening volume is at least 1.0x its recent average.
The stop-loss goes at the low (long) or high (short) of that first candle.
The take-profit is 10 times the risk away, so most trades end at the close instead.
Close every position 5 minutes before the market closes. One trade per stock per day.
